_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Vharlen's own angling text, laid over data/provinces/angling.json key by key (js/sim/province-files.js): `fish` (warm-water and volcanic species, bands 10-20 — Vharlen's catch list; Torbor's own fish never pass level 10), `legends` (one per Vharlen zone), `anglers` (one per Vharlen hub town; tools/content-pools.mjs --province=vharlen stands them on the bank) and `pullBack` (Vharlen monsters). Rods, bait, meals, recipes, junk and crates are Torbor's. The server joins every province's fish, legends, anglers and pull-backs into the one catch table (js/sim/angling.js), so a fish caught here stays a fish anywhere. Same row shapes as angling.json; checked by tests/C/vharlen-content.test.js.

fish.name: Black Sand Sole
fish.desc: Flat, black, and lying on black sand. You only find it by stepping on it.

fish.name: Harbour Sprat of Vharl
fish.desc: Silver, warm to the touch, and everywhere the boats are.

fish.name: Ashfin Snapper
fish.desc: Grey fins, red mouth, a temper to match. Bites the hook and then the line.

fish.name: Slagjaw Grouper
fish.desc: Lives in the cracks of cooled lava under the surf. Its jaw is as hard as the rock it hides in.

fish.name: Glass Ray
fish.desc: A ray so clear you can see the sand through it, and the hook inside it.

fish.name: Mother's Marlin
fish.desc: The Vharl say it swims round the island once a year to count it. It does not like being counted back.

fish.name: Springwater Tilapia
fish.desc: Only lives where the water is warm enough to bathe in. Tastes of the spring.

fish.name: Sulphur Minnow
fish.desc: Yellow, tiny and nearly inedible. Toads love them, which is why toads come looking.

fish.name: Crater Cichlid
fish.desc: Bright as a lamp and as bad-tempered as the lake it lives in.

fish.name: Boilfin Gar
fish.desc: Swims in water that would cook anything else. Comes out of the pot looking offended.

fish.name: Steam Trout
fish.desc: Leaps the hot falls in the jungle. Cooks itself if you are slow.

fish.name: Ashwater Barb
fish.desc: Grey with river ash, whiskered and patient.

fish.name: Mudvent Loach
fish.desc: Lives in mud that bubbles. Slick enough to slide out of a fist twice.

fish.name: Fumarole Catfish
fish.desc: Whiskers like wet rope. Hunts by the warmth of whatever falls in.

fish.name: Hotmud Lungfish
fish.desc: Breathes air, swims in mud, and has outlived three eruptions. Possibly the same one.

legends.name: Blackwater Queen
legends.desc: A sole the size of a door that lies under the harbour at Port Vharl. The pier pilings are worn smooth where she rubs.
legends.title: of the Black Sand

trophy.name: Blackwater Queen's Fin
trophy.desc: A black fin, edged with gold. Still warm.

legends.name: Old Scald
legends.desc: A trout that lives in the hottest pool of the Steamwood. Its back is pink from it.
legends.title: the Scalded

trophy.name: Old Scald's Gill-plate
trophy.desc: Pink, thin as paper and too hot to hold for long.

legends.name: The Yolk
legends.desc: A minnow grown huge and yellow in the acid pools. Nobody eats it. Everybody wants to catch it.
legends.title: of the Yellow Pools

trophy.name: The Yolk's Scale
trophy.desc: A yellow scale that stains anything it touches.

legends.name: Mudfather
legends.desc: A lungfish older than Stiltreach. It sighs, and the whole fen bubbles.
legends.title: the Mud-Wise

trophy.name: Mudfather's Whisker
trophy.desc: A whisker as thick as a finger, still twitching.

legends.name: The Mirror Eel
legends.desc: An eel with a glass skin that hunts in the surf off the obsidian dunes. You see yourself in it as it bites.
legends.title: of the Glass Surf

trophy.name: Mirror Eel's Skin
trophy.desc: A strip of skin that is a mirror on one side.

legends.name: The Last Drop
legends.desc: A fish caught once in the well at Lastwell, and twice in the sea below the wastes. Nobody agrees how it got in the well.
legends.title: of the Last Well

trophy.name: The Last Drop's Fin
trophy.desc: A grey fin that smells of the sea and of ash.

legends.name: Ashjaw
legends.desc: A barracuda that hunts in the ash-milk water where the buried valley meets the sea.
legends.title: the Ash-Fisher

trophy.name: Ashjaw's Tooth
trophy.desc: A tooth with ash ground into it.

legends.name: Kilnback
legends.desc: A grouper that lives under the sea cliffs of Kiln Ridge, red as a fired brick.
legends.title: of the Basalt Steps

trophy.name: Kilnback's Scale
trophy.desc: A red scale with a fingerprint baked into it.

legends.name: The Mother's Eye
legends.desc: The Rim-keepers say there is one fish in the crater lake, and it watches the shrine. They are right about the fish.
legends.title: Who Met the Eye

trophy.name: The Mother's Eye
trophy.desc: A round, hot scale like a coin of the island's oldest mint.

anglers.name: Nessk Thallu
anglers.greeting: Harbour fish bite at the pier. Deep fish bite your fingers. Keep the two apart.

anglers.name: Oru Keshvar
anglers.greeting: Fish in the hot pools come out half-cooked. Saves a fire.

anglers.name: Tekk Sulvenn
anglers.greeting: Do not drink from the yellow pools. Do fish them. Rinse after.

anglers.name: Pirra Nuvaru
anglers.greeting: I fish off my own doorstep. The doorstep is three men high.

anglers.name: Lorr Imbaru
anglers.greeting: Mind the beach. It cuts. The fish do not mind it.

anglers.name: Kirra Askaru
anglers.greeting: The sea is the only thing out here that is not on fire. I like the sea.

anglers.name: Gethu Rhovek
anglers.greeting: The water's grey with ash. The fish are grey with ash. I am grey with ash.

anglers.name: Halla Tovaru
anglers.greeting: Long line, long cliff, long wait. Worth it.

anglers.name: Rim-keeper Essu
anglers.greeting: We do not take from the lake. We borrow, and we put back. Mostly.

pullBack.say: The line goes slack. Then the surf stands up and has teeth.
Something black and warm comes up the beach after its supper. Your supper.
Your catch has legs, a yellow belly and an opinion.
That was not a log. That was never a log.
Something pulls back. It is coming up the bank, steaming.
